_note: This file is tracked, so it is public: it must never hold a credential and must never name an internal service endpoint. The organisation's own servers resolve their address and their token from the environment — MCP_GATEWAY_URL / MCP_GATEWAY_TOKEN and DB_GATEWAY_URL / DB_GATEWAY_TOKEN — and fall back to the reserved .invalid hosts below, which resolve nowhere. Add a server that needs more than an environment variable locally instead: `claude mcp add --scope local ...` keeps it out of this file and out of the repository.
